name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three HTTPS static-content virtual hosts, including site definitions, document roots, TLS certificates, and service enablement. It also applies firewall, Fail2ban, sysctl, and SSH hardening configuration.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and an authenticated Redis instance on port 6379. It creates the Redis log directory, enables Redis, and removes selected Redis configuration directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from Git into a Python virtual environment with its dependencies. It provisions local PostgreSQL, writes application environment configuration, and manages a systemd Uvicorn service on port 8000.
